title: WSDG/WSUG: add missing asciidoc admonition icons

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 19fb8968 - WSDG/WSUG: add missing asciidoc admonition icons
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6180/diffs?diff_id=326776889&start_sha=473e4783d0d358362062ab23241aaa6864e5b337)

It might make sense to use images from the same source in order to ensure a consistent look.

We could do what Asciidoctor does when "[Font Icons Mode](https://docs.asciidoctor.org/asciidoc/latest/macros/icons-font/)" is enabled and use [Font Awesome](https://fontawesome.com/). Its font files are released under the SIL OFL 1.1 license which isn't [GPL-compatible](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/license-list.en.html), but the individual SVG files are under the CC BY 4.0, which *is* compatible:

![asciidoctor-admonitions](/uploads/3ece8742452e217a9a502a84c7887a13/asciidoctor-admonitions.png)

Another option would be [ionicons](https://ionic.io/ionicons). Fonts and SVGs are both released under the MIT license:

![ion-admonitions](/uploads/4f3b8746e17bb00365f1f52399d10310/ion-admonitions.png)

Finally, [Bootstrap Icons](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/) are also available under the MIT license:

![bootstrap-admonitions](/uploads/0938d92d1240a62cdd9d39a58355f8c0/bootstrap-admonitions.png)

I like Bootstrap's the best, but I'd be fine with any of the three.
Asciidoctor sorts these by what appears to be severity: https://docs.asciidoctor.org/asciidoc/latest/blocks/admonitions/#admonition-types

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6180/diffs?diff_id=330746703&start_sha=19fb8968387f57f51ec3752f06b2faf0701ef2de#f9698f8333f4fceacfcce12c24aeb9b4add8a710_58_58)

Not that  I'm a huge fan, but the "Slippery When Wet" road sign was probably my best chance for ever getting a Bon Jovi reference into Wireshark. :-)  
I'd like to look at both the regular and the filled version in the document context then will amend the commit.
  
Note:
[sticky](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/sticky/)
[sticky-fill](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/sticky-fill/)

(pencil-square would also be good for note.
[pencil-square](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/pencil-square/))


Tip:
[lightbulb](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/lightbulb/)
[lightbulb-fill](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/lightbulb-fill/)


Important:
[exclamation-circle](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/exclamation-circle/)
[exclamation-circle-fill](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/exclamation-circle-fill/)

Caution:
[lightning-charge](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/lightning-charge/)

Warning:

[exclamation-triangle-fill](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/exclamation-triangle-fill/)
